style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the wholes the child cuts are a roti, a pizza and a chocolate bar: toasted-crust and chocolate-brown keys, a berry-pink Enter as the treat of the same table; never red, never violet

images.why: Description 'a chapati' and the shelf's 'round chapati with toasted spots': the whole roti on the shelf and the amber board, clipped per wedge when the Cut dial cuts it; the same picture clipped unevenly in code is the torn roti; and, drawn small (about 80 across), each thing in phase 4's Group view row of rotis
images.prompt: A round Indian chapati roti, toasted golden-tan with a few darker brown toasted spots and a soft, slightly puffed, uneven rim.

images.why: Description 'a pizza' and the shelf's 'pizza with toppings': the whole pizza on the shelf, the amber board, the blue plate and phase 3's pizza box; clipped per wedge, each wedge keeps its crust on the outer arc
images.prompt: A round pizza with a golden-brown puffy crust rim, melted pale-yellow cheese, a scatter of brown mushrooms and golden pepper rings.

images.why: the shelf's 'chocolate bar with its squares' and phase 2's bar to cut and lift: one whole smooth bar, drawn once at the board's 320 length and clipped per part (equal widths come from code)
images.prompt: One whole long milk chocolate bar, smooth and glossy with a softly bevelled edge and rounded corners.
